Tornado prediction accuracy

Definitive out-of-sample results for HazardPulse Tornado Coherence v1. Every number on this page comes from a single, locked evaluation on 2024 test data that the model never saw during training or tuning.

System overview

ModelHazardPulse Tornado Coherence v1
ArchitectureGBT on ProbSevere v3 + HRRR + Coherence Field Theory (Helmholtz PDE)
Trees / depth / lr37 trees, depth 4, lr 0.05 (early-stopped)
Label window40 km radius, 60 min forward
Training2021–2022 (6,120 storms, 1,020 positive)
Validation2023 (2,880 storms, 480 positive)
Test2024 (5,310 storms, 885 positive) — fully out-of-sample
Audit Zero leakage confirmed

Strict temporal split. No meta-stacker. No hyperparameter tuning on test set. Single test evaluation. Unknown-timing labels excluded (n=0 after filtering). All code at github.com/Jphilbrick10/hazardpulse.

Definitive results (2024 test set)

Model variant AUC 95% CI PR-AUC Brier BSS Significance
Baseline (ProbSevere only) 0.803 [0.792, 0.819] 0.355 0.125 +0.099 —
Enhanced (+HRRR atmosphere) 0.878 [0.867, 0.889] 0.561 0.113 +0.187 +0.075 over baseline, p<0.0001
Full (+Coherence Field Theory) 0.894 [0.883, 0.904] 0.606 0.114 +0.180 +0.016 over enhanced, p<0.0001

Source: definitive_results.json. Bootstrap CIs from 1,000 resamples. p-values from paired bootstrap DeLong test. Base rate: 16.7% (885/5,310).

Theory test results

Each model variant is a strict superset of the previous one. The lift is measured as the AUC difference on the same held-out 2024 test set.

  • HRRR atmospheric features add +0.075 AUC over ProbSevere alone
    95% CI: [0.062, 0.083], p<0.0001. Adding 3D atmospheric state from HRRR (shear, CAPE, moisture, STP) substantially improves discrimination. This is expected and validates the feature engineering.
  • Coherence Field Theory adds +0.016 AUC over HRRR
    95% CI: [0.012, 0.020], p<0.0001. The CFT features (tau, alignment, grad_tau, S/Gamma, Da) provide statistically significant additional signal beyond conventional meteorology. The effect is real but modest — we do not overclaim.
  • 4 of the top 15 features in the full model are from CFT
    1 srh01 (conventional) 2 tau (CFT) 3 alignment (CFT) 4 storm_speed_ms 5 alignment×CAPE (CFT)
    grad_tau ranks #15. Feature importance is split frequency (not causal attribution).

Comparison to published systems

System AUC / Score Data used Published Notes
HazardPulse (ours) 0.894 AUC ProbSevere + HRRR + CFT 2026 Storm-object, 60-min forward, 2024 test
TorNet CNN (MIT) 0.874 AUC Full dual-pol radar imagery AIES 2025 +0.020 AUC advantage; we need no radar imagery
ProbSevere v3 tornado ~0.85* Radar + satellite + lightning + NWP WAF 2024 +0.044 AUC advantage; we add coherence physics
TORP (NSSL) POD 57%, FAR 50% Single-radar rotation tracks WAF 2023 Different target (rotation); complementary approach
NWS tornado warnings POD ~75%, FAR ~70% Human forecasters + all data Operational 13-min lead time vs. our 60-min storm-object window
WoFS (NSSL) Ensemble guidance 3 km NWP with radar DA WAF 2023 Different product entirely; 0–6 h ensemble, not storm-object

*ProbSevere v3 tornado-specific AUC is not published; Cintineo et al. (WAF 2024) report "modest improvement over v2." Our 0.85 estimate is approximate.

Important caveat on cross-system comparisons. Direct comparison across these systems is approximate. Each uses different test sets, time periods, prediction targets, and evaluation methodologies. Our AUC of 0.894 was evaluated on 2024 ProbSevere storm objects with strict temporal labeling (40 km, 60 min forward window). TorNet uses radar imagery classification on a different storm sample. ProbSevere v3 evaluates on its own operational dataset. NWS warnings target imminent tornadoes with 13-minute average lead time. These systems are complementary, not directly comparable. We present this table for context, not to claim superiority.

What makes this different

  • Coherence Field Theory

    First tornado prediction system grounded in a unified physics framework. The coherence field (S_One) generates a Helmholtz PDE whose solutions produce tau (coherence time), alignment (field-flow coupling), and gradient features that capture mesoscale organization beyond what conventional indices measure.

  • Honest by design

    Zero-leakage architecture verified by audit. Strict temporal split with no data from the future leaking into training. No meta-stacker. No ensemble of ensembles. A single gradient-boosted tree per variant, early-stopped on validation loss.

  • Transparent

    Every prediction is logged with a SHA-256 hash chain. The full results JSON, feature importances, and model configuration are published. All code is open-source. We publish our false alarm rate and do not hide failures.

  • Self-aware limitations

    The CFT contribution is +0.016 AUC — real but modest. We do not claim to replace NWS warnings, ProbSevere, or radar-based systems. This system adds a new physics-based signal. It works best as a complement to existing tools.
